settings.heading: Cookie policy
settings.lead: Which cookies echobyjmg.com uses and how to change your choice.

settings.title: What cookies are
settings.text: Small files saved in your browser that let the shop remember your bag and, if you accept, measure visits and show relevant ads.

settings.title: Cookies we use
settings.text:
Necessary: bag, checkout and security. Always on.

Statistics: tools that show us how the shop is used. Only with consent.

Marketing: advertising tags from the platforms we advertise on. Only with consent.

settings.title: Change your choice
settings.text: You can change or withdraw your consent at any time.
